written_before: any payload byte of webqsp.tgz / CWQ.tgz / entities_names.json was fetched, and before any union measurement
why_this_file_exists: The outcome semantics of the union test must be fixed BEFORE the number is known, otherwise the threshold can be tuned to whatever the measurement returns. WEBQSP_SOURCE_MATRIX.json (2026-09-05) already pre-committed the three-way verdict; this file reproduces it UNCHANGED, pins the numeric boundary that document left in prose, and adds the two gates agreed in discussion on 2026-09-06.

hypothesis.statement: The union of NSM's released per-question subgraphs (webqsp.tgz + CWQ.tgz) is the MID-keyed preimage of the released RoG WebQSP+CWQ graph.

prior_evidence_for.item: NSM preprocess_step1.py get_subgraph() emits {'kb_id': head, 'text': head} -- MIDs in both fields (prior audit, code read)
RoG README names RichardHGL/WSDM2021_NSM/preprocessing/Freebase as its extraction recipe
GNN-RAG ships a separate entities_names.json; a name lookup would be pointless if the graph already carried names

prior_evidence_against.item: RoG's verb is 'We extract' -- a re-run, not a re-use of NSM's tarballs
RoG-webqsp has 4,700 examples vs NSM's 4,737 -- a 37-question delta, direct evidence against exact equality
RoG's WebQSP seed population and its MID->name projection step are both unreleased

hypothesis.what_the_test_converts: MID preservation in NSM's RELEASED artifact is currently [I], inferred from a code audit of the generator plus the existence of entities_names.json. The file has never been opened. Opening it converts [I] -> [V] regardless of what the union count says.

targets.source: released RoG WebQSP+CWQ union, measured by prior audit
targets.endpoints_are_not_an_acceptance_criterio: The paper's 2,566,291 and our measured 2,592,894 differ by +26,603 (+1.04%) and no counting convention explains the delta (strip / whitespace / NFC / casefold / drop-literals / head-only all tested and rejected). Endpoints are REPORTED, never used to accept or reject.

outcome_semantics_PRECOMMITTED.note: The three verdicts are reproduced UNCHANGED from WEBQSP_SOURCE_MATRIX.json -> targets.WEBQSP_ROG_MID.routes.A_nsm_released_subgraph_union.falsifiable_test.outcome_semantics_precommitted. Only the numeric boundary between verdict 2 and verdict 3 is new; that document left it in prose ('close but not exact' vs 'far off').
outcome_semantics_PRECOMMITTED.measurement: Union ALL triples across ALL questions in BOTH tarballs, MIDs as-is, no dedup by surface. Measure |E| distinct triples, |R| distinct relations, |V| distinct endpoints.

verdicts.verdict: RESOLVED. Artifact is the MID preimage; RoG surfaces become a derived display field.
verdicts.action: Populate V1 source_mid from the mapping WHERE THE MAPPING IS VALID. The 37-question split delta must still be reported.

verdicts.condition: not EXACT, and abs(triples - 8309195)/8309195 <= 0.10 and abs(relations - 7058)/7058 <= 0.10
verdicts.verdict: NOT RESOLVED. It is a sibling extraction and must be named WEBQSP_NSM_MID, never presented as the RoG graph. Report the delta.
verdicts.action: Freeze as a MEASUREMENT INSTRUMENT. Do not index it. Do not report retrieval numbers on it.

verdicts.condition: outside the SIBLING band on either axis
verdicts.verdict: Route A refuted; only route B (Freebase backend re-extraction, = V3) remains.
verdicts.action: Record the refutation and stop this branch.

outcome_semantics_PRECOMMITTED.boundary_justification: 10% is set from the two nearest known reference points, both measured before this test: (a) the 37-question split delta is 0.79% of RoG's 4,700 examples, and triples scale roughly with questions, so ~1% is attributable to the split alone; (b) camazlucas/Freebase-WebQSP-CWQ-Subgraph, which is genuinely DOWNSTREAM of RoG rather than a sibling of it, lands 0.61% short on triples (8,258,891) and 0.23% short on relations (7,042). A sibling extraction with a different unpublished seed list should sit further out than a downstream reconstruction, but an artifact more than 10% away on either axis is not recognisably the same extraction. The band is set once, here, and is not adjusted after the measurement.
outcome_semantics_PRECOMMITTED.v1_is_never_hostage: In ALL THREE verdicts v1_corpus_changes is false. V1 builds on the released RoG graph in parallel with this branch and does not wait for it. Head-to-head comparability against RoG / GNN-RAG / ReaRev requires the artifact those systems were evaluated on; a MID-split graph forfeits that even though it is the scientifically cleaner object.

cvt_encoding_gate_PREREGISTERED.registered_before: any CVT record text is rendered, and before any encoder is run
cvt_encoding_gate_PREREGISTERED.question: Of all WebQSP/CWQ gold answer strings, how many appear in some CVT's rendered record text and in NO entity's rendered text?
cvt_encoding_gate_PREREGISTERED.why_this_and_not_a_heuristic: The alternative -- a CVT eligibility heuristic over named_argument_count / distinct_relation_count / rendered_token_count -- has a free threshold, and a free threshold tuned after seeing retrieval numbers is not a measurement. This quantity has no free parameter and is computable from the frozen graph with ZERO encoder cost.

inputs: official WebQSP + CWQ gold answer strings
computation.matching: exact normalised string containment, normalisation fixed in advance: NFC, casefold, collapse internal whitespace. No fuzzy matching, no partial credit.
computation.denominator: all gold answer strings across both benchmarks, reported with and without deduplication
computation.cost: minutes; no encoder, no ANN, no embeddings

decision_rule.near_zero: CVT encoding is dead weight for this benchmark. Entities-only. CVT text is still GENERATED and stored (it costs ~nothing and preserves the option), but gets retrieval_role = STRUCTURAL_ONLY.
decision_rule.materially_non_zero: CVT records are a real retrieval lever. Proceed to cost the token-level Dense/SPLADE bill and only then decide E / E+C / E+ALLC.
decision_rule.threshold_deliberately_not_pinned_here: Unlike the union test, this gate's boundary depends on a distribution nobody has measured. Pinning a number now would be false precision. What IS pinned: the quantity, its normalisation, its denominator, and the rule that it is computed BEFORE any encoding decision and reported whatever it says.

standing_caution.finding: 54-78% of loss occurred on queries whose coverage was UNCHANGED -- pure pool-composition sensitivity
standing_caution.consequence: Admitting 1,588,085 CVT nodes to the L1 pool is exactly that class of change. A recall gain from CVT admission is not established until pool-composition effects on UNCHANGED-coverage queries are separated out.

cost_note.correction: local-cpu-encoding-ceiling recorded '2.57M bare is viable'. That was measured on BARE rows. A role-labelled CVT record is roughly 25-40 tokens against ~8 for entity core text, and the dense bill scales with TOKENS not ROWS.
cost_note.consequence: All-CVT is not '2.576M vs 988k rows'; it is close to an order of magnitude more compute than the row count suggests. Budget in tokens.
